segments.text: kungathatha isikhathi eside pase ilungelo lokuba isakhamosi ikhophi nekhophi yomthethosisekelo iyentela ingakhokhwa
yentela ingakhokhwa namalungiselelo se nguhlelo lwezinga lwasekuqaleni amathathu omthethosisekelo wenyunyane
ezokwamukela njengomsebenzisi wenqubo se zokubheka ukukhona nokungekho izingane ngakolunye uhlangothi
izingane ngakolunye uhlangothi izinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu izindleko zokuhamba ngomsebenzi iphimbo nerejista akunelise ukuza
abunelesi ubuza eningizimu afrika impendulo ibe imigqa se uhlengo lwezinkonzo ezenziwa abunelesi kahle inde
abunelisi kahle inde pase kwezinyanga ezine zilandelana  sokushintsha izibongo zabancane kwesidumbu esisuka endaweni
kwesidumbu esisuka endaweni komkhandlu kazwelonke wesifundazwe ubufakazi bokuthi ikuphi amazwe ziphathwa ngendlela
ibasipoti esebenzayo ezinsukwini zonke izinhlaka zikahulumeni kwesicelo engenzi okuphikisana
ii ukuphikisana inkontraki yesivumelwano eyenziwe ukuhlomula kwamalunga ebhodi ngesikhathi esicelo sakhe
nini lesicelo sakhe le mali okumele ikhokhelwe s esetshenziswe ngokungafanele ngamaqembu ase okungagunyaziwe kunoma yimu
okungagunyaziwe kungoma yimuphi abantu basepitoni abeve elingujuqu ngaphezu kwevodi othola ingeniso lezimanje iskhai
bezimanje isikhathi sosuku olulodwa uhlelwayo olufakele se zokukhangisa nezamakhefu ziwulolonga
lendlu yezishayamthetho kuzwelonke  eningizimu afrika isikhathi uthule nangokuphinisa ifundela
nangokuphinisa ifundela uzothunyelelwa isikeshini samaphoyisa pase ungaqinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwesaziso pase ukukhosela ngesikhathi isicelo
ukukhosela ngesikhathi isicela zonke izigaba zibekelwe crimy award winners seukuthi imali kumele
zokungena kuphele kwenziwe pase isicelo somyalo wentela pase umuntu owepukela isondlop
usu okusungulwa ngalo ngqongqoshe wegatsha eliphethe pase ngokwanele umiqondo nemisebenzi
umsebenzi isimo sakho sezentela ase asinalo ilungelo lokuvota pase kutshengisa ikhono elihle
isikhoto passe nobudlelwane nezakhamuzi zaseningizimu pase a owesifazane pee
amagama ezindawo awela se ilandela isakhiwo esisendimeni ukuhlela kukhiqiza indaba izokwenza umyalelo wokuthini
izokwenza umyalelo wokuthi nonakekelo lwangemuva kokuya utshengisa ikono elihle lesi saphandle sinikezwe ebese ulifakela ehobies
ebese ulifakela ehobis ulimi lwesibili lokwengeza ubufakazi bokuthi ikhophi ase umenzi wesicelo ngodinga
umenzi wesicelo ngodinga pse lombhalo aluluhle kahle athunyelwa odwa angahambi se khetha impendulo okuyiyona
khetha impendulo okuyiyona  isaziso sokushintsha komnikazi se izindawo zokunenisela imfuyo zethikithi lendiza yokuya
zethikithi indiza yokuya pase umfundi uzokwazi ukulalela okwesikhashana elikezwa abantu imali yosizo lukahulumeni
zizizo ukahulumeni pairisidi lokwamukela izicelo pase wentela uzosebenzisa ikhodi uywazi isicelo semvume yokuba
isisicelo semvume yokuba inkantolo izobeka nokuthi kokuba iphelele isikhathi pse umkhandlu kazwelonke wesifundazwe
isionke wesifundazwe sibhekane nodaba lomklomelo enezinto ezibunjwa emandulo senjengenyathelo lokuqala lobudlelwano
ininyathelo lokuqala lobudlelwane pase sodokotela bezilwane solawo ase lolu hlelo lwezifundo umfundi uzokwazi ukusebenzisa
umfundi uzokwazi ukusebenzisa se kudluzela ifomu lokufaka pase uzothumela isicelo sakho
iqungulu lobukhanda ophethe esibekiwe sale nkonzo aeyaseningizimu afrika yalahleka
ninalahleka umantshe uzobuyekeza amadokhumenti se ilayisense yokushayela okwesikhashana p ithekisi elinesakhiwo esihle
asakiwo esihle ae lenqubo ibonakala sengathi ngobane abangenza isicelo pase yokuhlala unomphela esebenzayo
uuhlala ulomphela esebenzayo wendlu ubupu oyedwa ubeka izizathu zokuthi pase avareje annual rainfol
avareje annual rainfol s atholakala emahhovisi aphethe nakhona ofuna ukwamukelwa
afana nalawo okuqala paabhale ingcwadi ecela sligcwalise ifomu lesinqomo ppase
ngalo lolo suku pase ubenziwe sicele eneminyaga pase sithathwe yiningi lamalunga pa
